title: Paper accepted to CSCW 2026
summary: Our study of how teenagers perceive and mitigate gambling risks, based on their discussions on Reddit, was accepted to CSCW 2026.
details: “I usually profit because I know when to stop”: Understanding Teenagers’ Risk Perception and Mitigation Strategies of Gambling from Reddit — Yunhan Liu, Elena Koung, Qiurong Song, Yubo Kou, and Xinning Gui
